name: TradeRecords
description: Port books, customs ledgers and merchant accounts that record goods moved by a vessel or merchant.

contains_no_content_of_requested_type.description: Set to true if the input text contains no trade records. Otherwise, set to false.

vessel_or_merchant.description: The name of the vessel or of the merchant who shipped or received the goods, as written.

port.description: The port of loading, unloading or registration, as written. Use null if not stated.

cargo.description: The goods carried, as named in the source. Example: 'raw sugar'.

quantity.description: The quantity with its unit, as written. Example: '40 barrels'. Use null if not stated.

value.description: The recorded value of the cargo as a decimal number. Use null if not stated.

currency.description: The currency or monetary unit of the value, as written. Use null if not stated.

date.description: The date of the voyage, arrival or transaction, as written. Use null if the source gives no date.

source_page.description: The page or folio on which the entry appears. Use null if not identifiable.

notes.description: Remarks about the entry, such as the route or an uncertain reading. Use null if there are none.
